notes.title: Eastern Era | August Progress Update!
notes.notes: [p]Dear players, autumn has arrived, and our sect is becoming increasingly bustling. The Sect Master sits alone, savoring the fragrance of tea, while disciples gather to practice their skills.[/p][p]The cool autumn breeze sobers us up, and swords hang from tree branches like wind chimes.[/p][p]We're here to report on our recent progress, and we welcome your guidance![/p][p][/p][h3]UI Redesign and Optimization[/h3][hr][/hr][p]During the previous online livestream, we received a lot of feedback about the complex and awkward UI layout. We've gathered your feedback and referenced the UI layouts of excellent games to redesign and optimize the UI's style and layout, making it simpler and more intuitive, and more tailored to your experience.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453150/41cc13d8f04dbe946ad89aa402ef321a8b741e55.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Brand-New Face-Changing Gameplay Features[/h3][hr][/hr][p]Our face-changing system strives for ultimate freedom: facial features, bone structure, skin tone, and hairstyle are all adjustable to your heart's content. Whether you're a stern-eyed hero, a sinister and menacing villain, or a simple-minded underworld pawn, you can sculpt your own character.[/p][p]Beyond basic facial adjustments, we've also incorporated unique elements of ancientoriental culture for you to experience.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453150/61c2ee0c3bde97b39f34bc715cded109b4dbb049.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453150/de46e12dc14a29fd5b757de9d770c712deca4688.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Maps, a Different Experience.[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][p]In these maps, you'll encounter diverse Jianghu scenes and unpredictable enemies, facing unique challenges and choices.[/p][p]In these maps, you'll encounter diverse Jianghu scenes and unpredictable enemies, facing unique challenges and choices.[/p][list][*][p]Qingwusen — A vast sea of forests and lush green mountains, perpetually shrouded in a pale blue mist, making walking through it feel like entering a dream.[/p][/*][*][p]Juechenlan — Peaks stand face to face, the canyon is bottomless, the wind howls, the scenery is isolated and cold.[/p][/*][*][p]Liying Valley — A shrouded in shadow, a dreamlike interplay of light and shadow, strange rocks stand like ghosts, and the grass and trees whisper incessantly.[/p][/*][*][p]Luoxiawu — The afterglow is like a brocade, the forests are dyed in a vibrant color, and the lake reflects the colors. This place is tranquil, yet it seems to conceal unfinished stories from the Jianghu past.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453150/6506bebd6b44f80bf755b1d2f68793c5de4d86c1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Brand-New Buildings and Gameplay[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][p]Previously, we mentioned that in the sect, not only can disciples practice martial arts and swordsmanship, but gear guardians also stand watch. Yet when facing powerful enemies, that alone might not be enough. So we’re introducing the brand-new Mechanism Platform—a system that allows you to freely customize and upgrade your gear guardians! Every component can be swapped and assembled at will, letting you craft terrifying steel defenders with overwhelming combat power.[/p][p]The martial world is ever-changing, and word has it that Shaolin and Kunlun are locked in constant conflict. As a peace-loving sect, it’s only right that we step in to mediate. But… what if they refuse to listen?[/p][p]No worries—besides our unstoppable gear warriors, we’ve also developed futuristic black-tech Flying Devices![/p][p]You may have your Dragon-Subduing Palm, but I’ve got my Mechanism Cannons. If they won’t play fair, we’ll make sure they leave with dignity—one way or another.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453150/f2c34381bd313a8e8f9aaf224731566eaea7ba97.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453150/f2e602a3a4a3800068b7821a81e3676159316712.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]AI System Optimization and Enhancement[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][p]This time, we've significantly optimized the AI ​​system.[/p][p]Disciples' movements are now more natural and fluid; their behavior is no longer rigidly programmed, but more like real people.[/p][p]Within the sect, you'll see disciples coming and going, practicing or chatting. The sect operates in an orderly and vibrant manner, reminiscent of a true martial arts world.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453150/a6fcecebd64e0f5bf7c804caee05e654e67c5083.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Development Review[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][p]After the public PV release, we received many questions and suggestions from players both at home and abroad. Here we’ve collected some common questions about Eastern Era for interested players.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: What kind of game is this? What is the core gameplay?[/b] [/p][p][/p][p][b]A:[/b] Eastern Era is a simulation and management game themed around the construction of a classical Chinese martial arts sect, developed with Unreal Engine 5. Players take on the role of a sect leader on the run from enemies, starting anew in a barren land—recruiting disciples, cultivating resources, and gradually restoring the sect to glory. The core gameplay revolves around sect management: as the leader, you guide disciples, build facilities, recruit and train members, assign cultivation and production tasks, and carefully balance resource flow to maintain sustainable growth. Through interactions with other factions, players must weigh cooperation against rivalry, steadily developing their sect into a major power in the martial world. The game uses a panoramic interactive simulation where disciple behaviors are lifelike and the sect runs in an orderly system, combining strategic planning with the freedom of sandbox-style growth.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: What makes this game unique?[/b] [/p][p][/p][p][b]A:[/b] Distinctive large-scale sect battles bring the grandeur of wuxia warfare to life, while creative skill and martial arts combinations let players optimize team compositions. Key features include: custom sect leader creation with detailed face sculpting, cyber-wuxia themes with prosthetics and mechanical augmentations, and dynamic environmental effects. Weather, terrain, and other natural factors influence disciples’ personalities and growth paths, offering differentiated cultivation experiences. Within the simulation and martial world, sects can either pursue secluded cultivation or vie for dominance—building a one-of-a-kind wuxia world.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: How complete is the game now? When will it be released, and what will it cost?[/b] [/p][p][/p][p][b]A:[/b] A free demo will be available during the Steam Next Fest on October 13 this year. After gathering player feedback and further polishing, we plan to launch by the end of the year. Pricing is yet to be determined.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: What has been the biggest challenge during development?[/b] [/p][p][/p][p][b]A:[/b] Since going public, the game has received tremendous attention and suggestions from players. We’re both grateful and anxious, as our greatest fear is failing expectations. Building upon our previous work, we’ve integrated many new ideas—such as a large open world, dynamic weather (snow, rain, sunshine), and martial sect warfare—while also blending in some of the best community feedback. The biggest challenge has been balancing the core simulation management experience with players’ hopes for an authentic wuxia atmosphere. Striking that balance while adding innovative new systems has been our greatest test.[/p]

notes.title: July Team Development Progress Update!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello dear players, This is the Funyoo Game.[/p][p][/p][p]It's been almost two years since we launched our game. Our entire team has been so busy these days, immersed in development, that we haven't had much time to chat with you all. As a result, many of you who have been following us have been wondering, "What's the current state of the game? When will we be able to play it?" - We're so sorry! We haven't been slacking off yet. We're pushing ourselves to the limit, tackling various optimizations and challenges in the final sprint![/p][p][/p][p]We like to share a heartfelt update on what we've been working on. If you, like us, truly love single-player games, enjoy immersing yourself in their worlds, and enjoy sharing the pure joy of gaming with everyone, then we're sure the stories we're going through will bring a smile to your face, and even a little anticipation![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Trailer Review[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]In January 2025, we released our first trailer, introducing the game's world, landscape, and features. We received a lot of support and encouragement from players, which gave us even more confidence to make the game even better. We also received a large number of suggestions, which we have taken note of in detail and will fully consider in subsequent development. We would like to express our special thanks to all our players for their support. It is your encouragement that keeps us moving forward.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="gemgLb_sR40;full"][/previewyoutube][p]In June 2025, we released our second and third trailers. This time, we showcased more gameplay content, allowing players to directly see the gameplay, UI, controls, and combat. We recorded all of this in real-world gameplay. We hope you enjoy this gameplay and find it enjoyable, fun, and a unique sense of accomplishment found in management simulation games.[/p][p][/p][p]Similarly, after the release of this trailer, we received a large number of suggestions. We understand your needs: you want your sect to lead your disciples to conquer the world, rather than just be a nanny, taking care of their daily needs. We adjusted the release plan, adding many automated features and many interesting props, which will perform tasks and help carry supplies, keeping the sect running smoothly. This allows players, as the sect leader, to lead their disciples to conquer the martial arts world without any worries, and unify the martial arts world![/p][p][/p][h3][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3446240/_/"]Eastern Era | New Gameplay Revealed: Carve Your Path Brick by Brick, Reveal the World Sip by Bite!"[/url][/b][/h3][h3]
[b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3446240/_/"]Eastern Era | Development Log Featuring In-Game Footage[/url][/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b][u]Click the link above to watch the latest promotional video.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]INTO THE WORLD offline event review[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]At the end of June, at the invitation of Unreal Engine, our studio brought a playable demo of "Eastern Era" to the Unreal Engine booth at INTO THE WORLD in Beijing, showcasing an early demo version of the game to players for the first time. Numerous enthusiasts, game developers, and media members visited the offline booth to experience and test drive "Eastern Era" and communicate directly with us. We recorded every suggestion and every stuck point encountered by players, and will improve them in the upcoming online demo. Our original intention and goal remains to allow all players who are interested in and enjoy business simulation to experience the charm of "Martial Arts Sandbox" in Zongmen Origin. You will encounter familiar martial arts sects such as Shaolin, Wudang, and Kunlun in this world. Become allies or enemies? Fight or form alliances? The choice is yours.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453150/5331cde753c6dfac8db725f71967ad9c064539da.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Recent Dev progress[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]1.Scene Art Optimization[/b][/p][list][*][p]A ray tracing system has been introduced, significantly improving the game's visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]The overall scene polygon count has also been optimized, from 20 million to under 4 million. Combined with optimization technologies like Nantie, this ensures stable frame rates on mid-range and low-end graphics cards.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453150/79563cf92ceddb53e07e4b836aaef12e3ec8be89.png"][/img][/p][p][b]2.Character Model Optimization[/b][/p][list][*][p]Using Unreal Engine 5's latest MetaHuman technology, character models and facial expressions are made as realistic as possible.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453150/1cdd2f59c9a1452c86e2fb27e2a25eb072767f64.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]3.World Map Development[/b][/p][list][*][p]We've created a fully 3D world map. Players can communicate with various sects, trade with cities, and send disciples on expeditions and explore secret realms.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453150/7ec6bf07dd19f048887796b98983c51a39a65b25.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]4.Continued improvements to the home area.[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added the ability to craft mechanical birds, allowing you to transport goods and free up disciples' time.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new rooms with different functions, such as the library, dining hall, and armory, significantly increasing the playability of sect development.[/p][/*][*][p]Added numerous new decorations and practical furniture.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimize combat performance, which will be demonstrated in subsequent PvP events and is significantly improved compared to previous versions.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Below are some functional buildings we are planning. \[Mechanical Station] Here you can create various mechanical men and mechanical beasts. They are tireless and can take care of most of the chores in the sect as long as they are charged regularly. \[Mechanical Men] will diligently transport the treasures you find outside back to the sect warehouse without missing a single one. You can also create exclusive mechanical men to help you fight. And so on. There are interesting sandbox buildings like this waiting for you to play.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453150/1a33b141715127110a718e0519f11d921f0efdf5.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453150/9d53f301140afa122f90d1ec5c61b4fc51371ccd.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453150/e4f1e307c69a4af1e3b2580835b65c57cc9dd8d7.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453150/fe6d49fbba64d45f0a11add0baca7b822614b7c3.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]See you at Steam Next Fest![/h3][p][/p][p]On October 13th, we'll be participating in Steam Next Fest and bringing you a demo of "Zongmen Origin." The entire studio team sincerely invites you to download and play the game. We hope you enjoy it, and please feel free to contact us with any questions.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope this information has given you a better understanding of the game's vision, development progress, and latest updates for "Zongmen Origin." Thank you again for your continued attention and support![/p][p][/p][p]The Funyoo Game[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Contact Us[/p][p]Official Email: [url="https://funyoogame@163.com"]funyoogame@163.com[/url][/p][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/2xv5zN42"]https://discord.gg/2xv5zN42[/url][/p][p][/p]
